title: Copilot Organizational Rollout
problem: Copilot was rolled out to a 24-person engineering organization, but initial adoption and impact were limited because engineers needed structured workflows and guidance.
approach: Created targeted training modules, built custom usage guidelines, configured team prompts, and established monthly sharing sessions.
outcome: Substantial increase in active usage, and improved code consistency across development teams.
leverage: Multiplied team capacity and fostered shared organizational knowledge.

title: GeekSuite Development
problem: Traditional estimates forecasted 12-18 months of part-time work to build a personal productivity platform spanning multiple integrated apps.
approach: Leveraged advanced AI assistance for fast architectural design, prototyping, coding, and debugging.
outcome: Delivered the majority of the core platform features within a few months of nights and weekends.
leverage: Enabled solo developer velocity comparable to a small engineering team.

title: Python Learning Acceleration
problem: Needed working proficiency in Python to build validation scripts and automation utilities rapidly.
approach: Utilized AI model prompts as a virtual tutor, code reviewer, and pair programmer to explain language constructs in real time.
outcome: Acquired high working proficiency in approximately 48 hours and built real, production-ready validation tools.
leverage: Reduced learning curve time-to-delivery from weeks down to days.

title: geekPR Code Review Tooling
problem: PR reviews consumed significant engineering hours and frequently focused on repetitive lint/styling and basic design checks.
approach: Created an automated first-pass pull request review agent that handles static analyses and styling verification.
outcome: Reduced initial code review cycle time and improved code quality consistency before peer reviews.
leverage: Automated low-complexity checks, freeing senior developer hours for complex logic reviews.

title: Structured AI Workflow Methodology
problem: Long AI developer conversations frequently lost context, resulting in code regressions and wasted compute tokens.
approach: Implemented a rigid workspace document state workflow (THE_CONTEXT.md, THE_PLAN.md, THE_STEPS.md) to manage context boundaries.
outcome: Consistent developer outputs and higher efficiency transitions between model sizes during implementation.
leverage: Created a robust, repeatable developer loop that eliminates context rebuild steps.
